searchSummary.en: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5 on July 24, 2026, and made it the default model for Claude Max. The company introduced effort settings that let customers trade token use for task performance.
searchSummary.zhHans: Anthropic 于 2026 年 7 月 24 日发布 Claude Opus 5，并将其设为 Claude Max 的默认模型。该公司引入了 effort 设置，供用户在 token 消耗与任务表现之间取舍。

summary.en: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5 on July 24, 2026, and made it the default model for Claude Max. The company introduced effort settings that let customers trade token use for task performance.
summary.zhHans: Anthropic 于 2026 年 7 月 24 日发布 Claude Opus 5，并将其设为 Claude Max 的默认模型。该公司引入了 effort 设置，供用户在 token 消耗与任务表现之间取舍。

narrative.en: Anthropic reported that Opus 5 approached Claude Fable 5 performance at lower cost on several evaluations. Fortune described the release as a response to enterprise concerns about AI spending. The reported evaluation results were released by Anthropic and require continued independent comparison.
narrative.zhHans: Anthropic 报告称，Opus 5 在多项评估中以更低成本接近 Claude Fable 5 的表现。Fortune 将此次发布描述为对企业 AI 支出担忧的回应。相关评估结果由 Anthropic 发布，仍需持续的独立比较。

description.en: Anthropic reported improved coding, knowledge-work, and automation performance at the Opus price tier.
description.zhHans: Anthropic 报告称，Opus 价格档的编程、知识工作和自动化表现有所提升。

text.en: Anthropic released Claude Opus 5 on July 24, 2026 and made it the default model for Claude Max.
text.zhHans: Anthropic 于 2026 年 7 月 24 日发布 Claude Opus 5，并将其设为 Claude Max 的默认模型。

text.en: Anthropic introduced effort settings intended to trade token use for capability and cost.
text.zhHans: Anthropic 引入 effort 设置，旨在让用户在 token 消耗、能力和成本之间取舍。

text.en: Most launch benchmark claims came from Anthropic and should not be treated as independent consensus.
text.zhHans: 多数发布时的基准主张来自 Anthropic，不应视为独立共识。
